assessment: Custom prompt checks with explicit official-metric mapping; NOT official TMC/CR scores
covered_definition: Custom check implies the literal official existence predicate only. It does not imply all prompt requirements or the complete task pass.
official_evaluator: experiments/evaluate.py -> metric/<task>/metric.yaml -> src/schemas/dag.py; VLM calls src/vlm_utils.py
official_vlm: Upstream gpt-4o-mini via api.turboai.one; not invoked from an offline Tool and no substitute score is fabricated.

metrics.custom_check: Parse cleaned CSV, preserve original labels and official split; Phase 1 also asserts no missing values.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Agent checker does not calculate missing-cell percentage against official cleaned_data.csv. Schema split/target and no row exclusion are additional benchmark contracts; original prompt allows exclusion.

metrics.custom_check: Recompute held-out accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and ROC-AUC; reload checkpoint to reproduce predictions.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Accuracy >= .80 is our extra guard, not the official >= ground-truth accuracy. Columns y_true/y_pred differ from official Actual/Predicted; no official GT comparison.

metrics.custom_check: Check clustering row count and at least two clusters; Phase 1 verifies profiles against observed income rates.
metrics.difference_or_gap: No comparison of silhouette scores on the first 1000 rows against official clustering_results.csv. Official Cluster/income schema differs from current output.

metrics.custom_check: Require a readable PDF with substantive text, accuracy and clustering; official predicate only checks PDF existence.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Does not establish that EDA, figures, trends, anomalies or report interpretation are correct; those are prompt requirements beyond this official existence metric.

metrics.custom_check: Inspect actual saved Matplotlib bar heights, red fills and black edges; parse final PNG.
metrics.difference_or_gap: No VLM comparison against official bar image. Annual year positions, labels/scales, spacing and overall layout are not fully checked.

metrics.custom_check: Inspect dash-dot styles, three category lines and exact category sales totals; parse final PNG.
metrics.difference_or_gap: No VLM comparison; exact month alignment, category-to-color mapping, legends, axes and layout remain unchecked.

metrics.custom_check: Inspect seven actual scatter observations, alpha .5, sizes proportional to sales and three colors.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Official code compares Size/Color/Transparency in scatter_chart_data.csv against a GT CSV although that auxiliary output is not required by prompt and ground_truth is unspecified. Current check does not prove point-to-category color mapping, time positions or exact GT equality.

metrics.custom_check: Compare all finite nonnegative input incomes with cleaned CSV; retain repeated AGE/INCTOT pairs.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Official metric only compares cleaned row count with official GT, which has not been compared here. Exact input population is a stricter benchmark cleaning contract, not an official cleaning prescription.

metrics.custom_check: PNG is nonempty and decodable; actual plotted artifacts are replay-compared.
metrics.difference_or_gap: No VLM comparison and no independent check of Lorenz coordinates, axes or layout. Parsing/consistency cannot prove the chart represents the correct Lorenz curve.

metrics.custom_check: Independently recompute Gini from actual cleaned incomes and require atol=1e-6.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Official requires exact floating-point equality with GT text; this is a numerical consistency check, not official score equality.

tasks.scope: Phase 1 reference only; no LangGraph result validator yet

metrics.difference_or_gap: Does not compare the set of antecedent/consequent pairs against official GT with output precision >= .9.

metrics.custom_check: Phase 1 recomputes all persisted itemset supports from original baskets.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Does not compare itemset strings against official GT with output precision >= .9; binning/support choices may differ.

metrics.custom_check: Phase 1 requires and parses pattern_analysis_report.pdf.
metrics.difference_or_gap: File validity does not establish the interpretation quality.

metrics.custom_check: Phase 1 requires and parses client_segments_analysis.pdf.
metrics.difference_or_gap: File validity does not establish segment description quality.

metrics.custom_check: Original prompt outputs are checked in Phase 1.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Official metric asks for customer_segmentation_analysis.pdf, which original prompt does not require; no fabricated alias is added to claim a pass.

tasks.scope: Phase 1 reference only; no LangGraph result validator yet

metrics.custom_check: Phase 1 requires and parses all three named visualization PNGs; also checks country totals and monthly revenue.
metrics.difference_or_gap: Official predicate is file existence only; visual meaning/layout still not fully established.

metrics.custom_check: Phase 1 recomputes itemset supports and rule confidences against actual baskets.
metrics.difference_or_gap: No official GT frequent-itemset recall >= .9 comparison. Numerical validity is different from coverage of the official set.

metrics.difference_or_gap: Existence/parse success does not establish the narrative or business implications are correct.

metrics.difference_or_gap: Official asks for cleaned_data.csv and compares nonmissing Value1 count with GT; cleaned_data.csv is not a required output in the original prompt and is not an official-evaluated artifact here.

metrics.difference_or_gap: No MAE < .1 comparison with official predictions.csv. Holdout RMSE and official GT-prediction MAE are different quantities.
